snippet.description:
When Ethiopian Airlines Flight 961 departed from Addis Ababa on November 23, 1996, it was carrying 163 passengers and 12 crew members. Among them were an American diplomat, a legendary news cameraman, and a deadly plan. 

Are you able to figure out what the cause of this crash was?

From Season 3 Episode 13 "Ocean Landing": Twenty minutes into the flight, the three young men rushed the cockpit and hijacked the aircraft.  They demanded that the plane switch course to Australia – an 11-hour flight.  It was a suicidal request – the plane had only three hours of fuel.

Captain Leo Abate had been hijacked twice before. When he was unable to convince the hijackers to change their destination, he developed a backup plan. Without their knowledge, he headed toward the tiny Comoros Islands. An airport there might be his last chance.

snippet.title: The Daring Hostage Rescue That Changed Special Forces Forever
snippet.description:
Terrorists hijack Lufthansa Flight 181, rigging it with explosives and holding 86 hostages. Can Germany's GSG-9 pull off a daring rescue in Operation Fire Magic?

In this gripping documentary, we dive into the harrowing six-day ordeal of Lufthansa Flight LH181, hijacked in 1977 by members of the Popular Front for the Liberation of Palestine. As the terrorists threaten to blow up the plane and execute innocent passengers, German authorities face impossible choices and a race against time. You'll witness the psychological warfare, the escalating tension inside the stifling aircraft, and the extraordinary bravery of hostages and crew. 

Follow the elite GSG-9 Special Forces and their collaboration with British SAS as they plan and execute one of the most dangerous hostage rescue missions in history. Learn how intelligence, negotiation, and cutting-edge tactics - including the use of stun grenades and simultaneous multi-point entry - led to a textbook operation in Mogadishu that saved nearly all the hostages. Discover why Operation Fire Magic became a turning point in counter-terrorism and a blueprint for future rescue missions worldwide.

If you're interested in real-life hostage rescues, Special Forces history, or dramatic stories of survival against the odds, this video delivers a powerful account of one of the most legendary anti-terrorist operations ever undertaken.

snippet.description:
Lufthansa Flight LH 181 was an ordinary holiday flight until October 13, 1977, when four PFLP terrorists turned it into a six-day nightmare. They rigged the Boeing 737 with plastic explosives, held 86 passengers and crew at gunpoint, and forced a diversion from Rome through Cyprus, Bahrain and Dubai to Mogadishu. As tensions reached breaking point—with hostages beaten, the cabin sweltering without air conditioning, and a ticking time bomb under every seat—Germany’s new elite unit GSG 9 teamed up with SAS advisers to plan the most daring hostage rescue in history. Follow the political wrangling, the coded cigar-packet gambit from Captain Schumann, and the intense rehearsals on a mock-up jet before Operation Fire Magic stormed the aircraft in Somalia. The seven-minute assault that freed every hostage and neutralized the hijackers still serves as the blueprint for special-forces missions worldwide.

The hijacking of Air France Flight 8969 became a deadly standoff, leading to one of history’s most daring anti-terror operations. Discover the forgotten story.

In this gripping documentary, we recount the harrowing events of Christmas 1994 when four armed extremists seized an Air France Airbus A300 in Algiers, launching a terrifying 54-hour ordeal for 173 passengers and crew. Through eyewitness testimony and rare video footage, we reveal the tense negotiations, the chilling motives of the hijackers, and the high-stakes decisions facing both the Algerian and French governments.
